exception where the invention relates to the business or anticipated R&D, or results from work for the employer
the written notice is given under §2870
assertions.note: MISCITATION. §2870 creates the substantive carve-out; §2872 is the section that requires the employer to give written notice of it. The clause cites the wrong section for the obligation it is performing, which is the thing a reviewer would be relying on it for.

gaps: A provision purporting to require assignment of a §2870-protected invention is against the public policy of California and unenforceable. The clause states the carve-out but not that an overbroad assignment is void, which is the consequence that matters.
§§2870–2872 govern employees. The clause is drafted for founders and sits in the founder IP assignment; a founder who is not an employee may not be covered, and the clause does not flag that.

The same opinion records that the district court found §2872 "states no remedy for its violation" and treated the absence of notification as not determinative. A clause that tells an employer to give the notice without indicating what turns on giving it leaves the reader unable to weigh the obligation.

judicialQuotations.case: Whitewater West Industries v. Alleshouse (Fed. Cir. 2020)
judicialQuotations.quote: Related to § 2870, California Labor Code § 2872 requires that an employer must "provide a written notification" to an employee that any assignment provision "does not apply to an invention which qualifies fully under the provisions of Section 2870."

judicialNote:
The Federal Circuit states the division of labour between the two sections in terms: §2870 defines which inventions cannot be assigned; §2872 is what requires the employer to give written notification. The clause cites §2870 for the notice duty, which is the defect this finding recorded, and a court quoting both sections confirms it.

ONE opinion, not two. A search of CourtListener for other opinions quoting §2872's operative language returns this case alone, so the two-opinion independence test cannot be completed for this provision from this database — that is a fact about the case law, not a gap in the search. The finding therefore stays at unverifiable-as-recorded. The rule is not being relaxed to let a finding of mine through.
